hero.title: A gifting platform for every relationship you manage.
hero.body: Campaigns, vendors, orders and every recipient roster: Wrapzzo runs the whole corporate gifting workflow in one place.

solutions.title: Built for every kind of corporate gifting
solutions.body: Whoever you're gifting (employees, clients, distributors, healthcare professionals or partners), it runs through the same platform.

employee.title: Employee Gifting
employee.description: Onboarding kits, milestones and everyday recognition for your team.
employee.caption: New-hire welcome kits, delivered the day an offer is accepted.

client.title: Client Gifting
client.description: Thoughtful gifting that scales with your client base.
client.caption: Renewal and anniversary gifts, sent on schedule.

dealer.title: Distributor / Dealer Gifting
dealer.description: Recognition programs for your distribution and dealer network.
dealer.caption: Nationwide dealer incentive gifting, tracked by territory.

pharma.title: Pharma / HCP Gifting
pharma.description: Compliant gifting and engagement for healthcare professionals.
pharma.caption: Doctor engagement gifting, handled with the care the sector needs.

events.title: Events & Conferences
events.description: Welcome gifts and merchandise for conferences and field events.
events.caption: Conference welcome kits, ready for attendees on day one.

welcome.title: Welcome Kits
welcome.description: Onboarding and induction kits for new employees or partners.
welcome.caption: Branded welcome kits, shipped nationwide on your timeline.

rewards.title: Rewards & Recognition
rewards.description: Performance-tied gifting for milestones and achievements.
rewards.caption: Quarterly recognition gifting, delivered on time, every time.

partner.title: Partner Gifting
partner.description: Gifting for the partners and vendors who help your business run.
partner.caption: Year-end appreciation gifting for your partner network.

cta.title: Ready to manage your next gifting program?
